OPTIMIZED FLIPPING CONFIGURATION
================================

GOAL: 
- Maximize DLS alignment to ONE hemisphere (Left).
- Maximize DMS alignment to ONE hemisphere (Right).
- Maintain balanced n_flipped vs n_kept per Genotype (WT, KI).

CONSTRAINTS:
- WT total: 8. Target: 4 flip / 4 keep.
- KI total: 9. Target: 4 flip / 5 keep.

BEST SCORES (DLS, DMS, VS): (10, 10, 6)
---------------------------------------
- DLS: 10/10 Aligned to LEFT.
- DMS: 10/10 Aligned to RIGHT.
- VS : 6 Right, 5 Left.

[728, 740, 1767, 1773, 1664, 1666, 1779, 1781]

KEEP ORIGINAL (9 MICE):
[1658, 1680, 1694, 1749, 1759, 1765, 1771, 1775, 1787]
